plate.vertical_crop: crop=302:536:CX-151:0 (after active crop) -> full active height, 9:16
plate.retime: setpts=(PTS-STARTPTS)/speed, minterpolate=fps=25:mi_mode=mci:mc_mode=aobmc:me_mode=bidir:vsbmc=1 (all clips, also 1.0x, so 23.976->25 has no duplicate-frame judder)
plate.transitions_centred_on_beat: each xfade of D frames runs from beat_frame - D/2 to beat_frame + D/2; the incoming shot is at 50% on the beat frame
plate.handles_rule: every clip's source window (including transition handles) stays inside its own trailer shot (scdet-measured cuts); speeds were adjusted where the treatment's speed plus handles would have crossed a cut
plate.graded_out: shots/sh010/edit/v004/bg_plate_1080.mp4 = same EDL rebuild + per-shot trims + lut3d warm.cube + color/v001/finish_filter.txt
plate.encode: libx264 -crf 14 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 25, exactly 375 frames, no audio

grade.applies_to: graded plate only (bg_plate_1080.mp4); raw plate has no trims
grade.per_shot_trims: cuts[].grade_trim, applied per clip BEFORE the xfade chain
grade.finish: shots/sh010/color/v001/finish_filter.txt verbatim (curves, sat 1.06, gblur 3, vignette PI/4.5, luma-only grain noise=c0s=6:c0f=t)
grade.note: LUT is plate-only; never on the HyperFrames type layer
